{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the `revenue` column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the transformation
print("Sample of cleaned revenue:", sales['revenue_clean'].head())
print("Data type of revenue_clean:", sales['revenue_clean'].dtype)

# Check for the six QA orders with 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order order_ids:", qa_orders['order_id'].tolist())"}
